title: 多智能体交易模拟高级工程师 / Senior Engineer – Multi-Agent Trading Simulation
description: 我们正在招聘一名多智能体交易模拟高级工程师，负责构建能够同时运行、评估和迭代大量交易智能体的研究平台。重点是可靠的模拟、实验基础设施和可重复的结果，而不是宣传式的“AI 交易”。工作职责 构建事件驱动的市场模拟器和可扩展的多智能体运行环境。 设计策略接口、回测、撮合、费用、滑点和风险模型。 管理数百到数千个智能体的调度、状态、日志和故障恢复。 建立实验追踪、基准、统计检验和防止数据泄漏的流程。 与研究人员一起把想法转化为可验证、可复现的实验。任职要求 常驻杭州或能在杭州工作，5 年以上后端、分布式系统或量化基础设施经验。 熟练使用 Python，并掌握 Go、Rust、C++ 或高性能数据系统中的至少一种。 理解回测偏差、市场微观结构、时间序列和实验设计。 能构建可靠系统并清楚解释性能与正确性的权衡。EnglishWe are hiring a Senior Engineer in Hangzhou to build a research platform that can run, evaluate, and iterate large populations of trading agents. The emphasis is reliable simulation and reproducible experimentation.Responsibilities Build event-driven market simulators and scalable multi-agent runtimes. Implement strategy interfaces, backtesting, matching, fees, slippage, and risk models. Orchestrate hundreds or thousands of agents with robust state, logs, and recovery. Create experiment tracking, benchmarks, statistical checks, and leakage prevention. Turn research ideas into testable, reproducible experiments. Requirements Based in or able to work from Hangzhou with 5+ years in backend, distributed systems, or quantitative infrastructure. Strong Python plus Go, Rust, C++, or high-performance data systems. Practical knowledge of backtest bias, market microstructure, time series, and experiment design. Able to explain and improve the tradeoffs between performance, correctness, and cost. Show more Show less
reason: Strong multi-agent orchestration and system design skills directly transfer, but lacks required 5+ years backend/distributed systems experience, Python/Go/Rust proficiency, and quantitative finance domain knowledge. Location requirement (Hangzhou-based) incompatible with UTC+1 remote preference.
